scope: manual movement controller for existing Luna Twin presentation

controller.shape: circular glass base with circular directional buttons and center Interact

movement.bounds: canonical interior or level footprint bounds
movement.collisionLimit: reference bounds only; full wall collision deferred
movement.translationBasis: camera yaw only; pitch discarded before movement
movement.strafe: A/D and left/right strafe on horizontal right vector; no keyboard rotation in V1
movement.eyeHeight: camera Y locked to captured walk plane during normal Explore movement
movement.smoothing: modest acceleration and damping with prompt release stop

targeting.method: center-screen raycast to userData.canonicalRef with selected-object fallback
targeting.policyAuthority: existing RepresentationPolicy and runtime route/capability checks

verification.lint: npm run lint PASS with existing warnings
verification.planarBrowser: npm run test:explore:planar-browser PASS; all measured movement deltaY=0.0000
